Subject: Executive salon — initial guest priority list + venue contract notes

Team,

Drafting the finalized invite list for the Executive Salon (San Francisco, Oct 7 — evening). Goal: 12 guests + 4 Redwood ambassadors. Attached are the seating chart draft and the latest venue contract they sent (contract_draft_v3.docx). High-level asks for this thread:

- Rishi: please mark top 8 customers we must lock (priority A/B/C).
- Marcus: any partner/alumni we want to include?
- Marissa: confirm whether we should save 2 seats for VCs/press.
- Julian (venue): quick callouts on insurance limits, food & beverage minimums, and NDA requirement — flagged in the contract.

Notes: venue requires proof of COI insurance at $1M general liability and a signed venue rider (see clause 4.2). They also requested that any customer press be approved 48 hours in advance.

I've sketched a guest-prioritization column in the seating_chart_v1.xlsx — please edit directly and reply by EOD 9/3. Also linking the Drive folder here for any collateral.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Events & Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0134

Subject: Re: Executive salon — initial guest priority list + venue contract notes

Stephanie —

Quick pass on priorities (pulled from active deals / exec relationships):
1) Sasha Green (Acme Health) — strategic expansion, strong renewal signal — A
2) Daniel Ortega (Atlas Bio) — potential dedicated pilot — A
3) Naomi Feldman (EdgeMetrics) — product integration lead — B
4) Jonas Weber (Nordic Labs) — industry influence — B
5) Connor O'Brien (Haven Security) — C (watch for compliance asks)
6) Mateo Alvarez (VectorOps) — C

I recommend reserving 2 ambassador seats for our CTO-presenter and one for Customer Success (Marissa). Also +1 for a small press guest only if pre-approved by customers.

On the contract: clause 4.2 is standard, but we should push insurance down to $500k for smaller customer-facing events (legal asked for precedent). Also we need a carveout for product screenshots — venues sometimes try to claim IP over media shot on-site (we should add explicit permission).

I'll populate the sheet with labels A/B/C.

-Rishi
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the note and the draft list — looks great. A few clarifications from The Upper House legal/risk:

- Insurance: standard is $1M GL; for private dinners we can accept $500k if the organizer is a Series A/B company and the menu is prix-fixe. Redwood qualifies so we can drop to $500k.
- Media: we can add an explicit clause allowing on-site photography/recording for Redwood collateral, provided guests who object are muted from any recordings. We will add a press-approval window.
- NDA/venue rider: we provide the rider but need an executed copy 14 days before the event.
- F&B minimum: $9,000 (excl tax & service).

I can send a marked-up contract by EOD today with the $500k option and a redline on the media clause.

Cheers,
Julian Park
Private Events Manager | The Upper House
julian@theupperhouse.com | 415-555-2100

Attachment: sample_menu_vegetarian.pdf

Team —

Legal is fine approving the $500k GL for this event given the guest composition and our existing umbrella policy. Two quick asks we will push on the contract redline from our side:
1) Add explicit indemnity carveout for customer-provided materials and screenshots (we won't transfer IP rights to the venue).
2) Replace any “press approval” wording with “written consent from Redwood” 48 hours prior — this gives us better control.

I'll review Julian's marked-up version when it arrives and propose exact language. If Julian can send the DocuSign link after the redlines are agreed, we can aim to return an executed rider by 9/23.

—Evelyn Hart
